title: Global strong solutions to a one-dimensional full non-Newtonian fluid with far field vacuum
summary: In this paper, the Cauchy problem for a one-dimensional heat conducting compressible non-Newtonian fluid is considered. The constitute equation of the non-Newtonian fluid is determined by two nonlinear terms $(|u_x|^{q-2}u_x)_x$ and $(|θ_x|^{p-2}θ_x)_x$ with $1<p,q<2.$ When the vacuum occurs at the far field, the local and global existence of strong solutions are established for the Cauchy problem.
